processing.selection: Use source.animations[0]; rename the cloned AnimationClip to its mapping key.
processing.skeleton: Idle FBXLoader static/rest T-pose bone-local position, quaternion and scale, captured immediately after parse. No mixer, animation evaluation or frame-0 pose is applied. Names are unchanged FBXLoader names; parent is the nearest ancestor Bone or null.
processing.coordinates: Y-up, +Z forward, centimeters. No axis conversion or baked scaling; unitScale=0.01 indicates centimeters to meters, applied once by the consumer.

rootMotion.method: Set X and Z to absolute zero at EVERY existing key, not first-key subtraction. Preserve every Y sample in original centimeters (apart from JSON decimal rounding).
rootMotion.reason: Prevent planar root translation from adding to rules-driven actor movement.
rootMotion.rotations: All rotation tracks, including Hips turns/yaw, are retained. No rotational root-motion removal.

processing.time: Keep FBXLoader clip durations, track order, all key counts and timestamps; no trim, optimize, resampling, downsampling or time scaling. JSON numbers, including duration/timestamps, are rounded to six decimal places only. Exact original durations are retained separately in this report.
processing.serialization: Three.AnimationClip.toJSON(clip), compact JSON with six-decimal numeric rounding; stable content-derived clip UUIDs for reproducible reruns.
processing.character: Byte-for-byte copy of the user-supplied self-contained Indian Man in Suit GLB. Runtime normalizes its 1.83x centimetre root scale to 1.8 m and adapts Mixamo-style joint names to the rig contract; no mesh conversion, no animation retargeting, embedded animation unused.
